strategies.name: fvg_first_candle_break_retest_engulfing_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute first candle of the day, mark that candle's high/low, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break the level with a fair value gap in the breakout direction. After price retests back into the FVG, enter only when the retest candle is engulfed.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss under the lowest point of the move into the fair value gap with one tick of breathing room. Take a fixed 3:1 profit target and do not micromanage the trade.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for retest into the FVG, then require engulfing confirmation before entry
variants.transcript_quote: we're going to wait for a retest of the fair value gap... then we wait for this retest candle right here to get engulfed... for our takerit, we are a

strategies.name: fvg_first_candle_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute first candle of the day, mark that candle's high/low, then switch to the 5-minute chart and wait for a breakout-created fair value gap in the chosen direction. Instead of waiting for a retest/engulf, place a passive limit order directly on the FVG so you are filled when price trades
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss right at the first candle in the fair value gap pattern, under that first candle. Take a fixed 2:1 profit target and let the trade run without micromanaging, even if price revisits the FVG.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: use a limit order directly on the FVG instead of waiting for a retest
variants.transcript_quote: instead of waiting for a retest, we're actually going to set a limit order on the FVG... we're going to target a fixed 2:1 return

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct strategy skeletons are taught: a 5m/1m break-retest-engulf scalp and a 15m/5m passive-limit day trade. They differ in entry logic and exit/management (3:1 vs 2:1, stop placement), so they are separate objects.
